description:
Create a comparative performance chart in NinjaTrader 8 for the year 2023.

Goal: Configure a single chart window that overlays SPY, AAPL, and MSFT to compare their percentage returns.

Requirements:
1. Open a new Chart.
2. Add 'SPY' as the primary instrument (Daily bars, 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31).
3. Add 'AAPL' and 'MSFT' as additional data series on the SAME chart panel (do not create separate sub-panels).
4. Configure the Vertical Axis (Right Axis) to use 'Percentage' mode so all lines start at 0% and show relative performance.
5. Save the workspace to preserve the configuration.
